dld_transfer.legal_basis: Executive Council Resolution No. 30 of 2013, Article 2, Schedule Item 1
dld_transfer.payer_rule: ECR 30/2013 Article 3(1): 'unless agreed otherwise, the Fee for the sale of Real Property will be shared equally by the seller and purchaser.' Market practice commonly has buyer pay full 4%.

title_deed.legal_basis: Executive Council Resolution No. 30 of 2013, Schedule Item 22
title_deed.note: AED 250 per title deed issuance. Does NOT include knowledge/innovation fees — those are separate.

knowledge_fee.threshold_rules: Not charged for transactions less than AED 50
knowledge_fee.note: Charged per government service transaction. Separate from title deed fee.

innovation_fee.threshold_rules: Not charged for transactions less than AED 50
innovation_fee.note: Charged per government service transaction. Separate from title deed fee.

trustee_office_fee.payer: Typically buyer, but varies by trustee office
trustee_office_fee.note: Trustee offices are private entities authorised by DLD. Their fees are NOT fixed by official government statute. Market sources cite AED 2,000-4,000 but this is NOT OFFICIAL_VERIFIED. Must be USER_INPUT.

property_map_fee.legal_basis: Executive Council Resolution No. 30 of 2013, Schedule Item 62
property_map_fee.threshold_rules: AED 250 for villa/apartment plan; AED 100 for land map; AED 225 for unified land map (Dubai Municipality)
property_map_fee.note: Optional — only if a new map/plan is required. Not always charged.

broker_purchase_commission.legal_basis: No statutory rate — regulated contractually (RERA Form B)
broker_purchase_commission.market_standard: 2% of sale price + 5% VAT (commonly cited, not statutory)
broker_purchase_commission.note: No default is ever applied. Must be explicitly entered by user.

developer_admin_fee.legal_basis: Varies by developer — no statutory rate
developer_admin_fee.note: Not universally applicable. Optional — does not block COMPLETE_ACQUISITION_COSTS.

mortgage_registration_fee.legal_basis: ECR 30/2013 Schedule Item 10 (0.25% of mortgage value)
